decision.title: Phase 2 gate review (packet )
decision.summary: The Phase 2 gate review passes: XP40 at 97.0 % in scope, fuzzing clean, every F&O 4.0 function present but the non-goals, with option readers and calendar rules merged and xquery.h and xslt.h provisional.

body.p: by the review agent (), after , , , . Checked locally (): tools/check-main.sh on a clean HEAD (c7c0c35) builds and tests , debug (ASan, UBSan), debug-gcc and wasm (Node.js package tests and size budget included) and lints clean, with no call cycle.

item.p: Numbers (code of ed225c2, , tools/run-qt4.sh): XP40 30,630 of 47,313 passed, 0 errors, no crash, every test set finished; in scope () 30,612 of 31,543, 97.0 %; by area, in scope: fn 95.5 %, op 99.2 %, prod 97.8 %, map 99.7 %, array 99.8 %, math 100 %, xs 99.5 %. Slice 198/198. XQ40 for the record: 39,541 passed, in scope 96.0 %, XQ-only 83.9 %, 1,568 errors (all module import, 3.11 running; 1,379 of them misc-HtmlTestSuite). Fuzzing, 300 s per target, all five at once, then the two XPath targets 300 s more: cast_fuzz 564,842 runs, regex_fuzz 320,438, xml_parse_fuzz 29,846, xpath_compile_fuzz 7,679, xpath_evaluate_fuzz 3,097 (fork mode, 12 to 16 runs a second on a loaded machine); no crash, leak, sanitizer report or timeout.

Functions: every function of F&O 4.0's signatures (282 names, looked up at arities 0 to 7) is in the library but 's non-goals (html-doc, parse-html, invisible-xml, xsd-validator, transform) and fn:load-xquery-module, which gives to 3.11.

through function pointers: native bodies that call function items are resumable (); the function-body, generator and resolver operations re-enter the evaluator only through sxml_evaluator_call_function_item, which refuses a running context (is_running); part tasks return to the machine. The lowering machine has no such guard: see the follow-ups.

Merged (the owner's principle of conceptual smallness): the options of fn:element-to-map, fn:map-to-element, fn:unparsed-text and fn:unparsed-text-lines are read by sxml_function_library_read_options (two private readers removed; an unknown key that is not a QName in a namespace is now XPTY0004 there too, F&O 4.0, section 1.7); one SXML_FUNCTION_OPTION macro for option tables instead of five; one calendar rule, sxml_year_is_leap and sxml_days_in_month (src/cast_internal.h), instead of four copies; the unused sxml_function_library_check_collation removed. XP40 and XQ40 outcomes are identical before and after, case by case.

Headers for 0.2.0 (, , ): consistent and documented (one undocumented declaration, sxml_sequence_get_representation, got its comment). xquery.h and xslt.h are provisional until the gates of Phases 3 and 4: their implementations are not done, and a Proposed item already changes xquery.h's contract. A minor release may change them, each change with a record (version.h, docs/RELEASE.md, CHANGELOG.md).

Proposed, the Phase 2 items: collations in min/max, highest/lowest, sort-by and array:sort were done by ; only the evaluator's SORT (order by with a collation, XQuery) still takes the codepoint collation alone, for Phase 3. The item axis () is accepted: SXML_AXIS_ITEM appended to sxml_axis (additive, ) with XPath 4.0, 4.7.4's STEP semantics, and the JNode key test reading the EQName form, for the next sweep. The XSLT driver's report name and areas () are accepted for 4.17. The three are out of Proposed. Left there: the owner's (the two WebAssembly budgets, XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default) and Phase 3 design work ('s prolog follow-ups, 's three items), for the Phase 3 gate.
Numbering: two records were ; the 3.3 one is now, with its references. follows (recorded in finishing order); kept.

Follow-ups (not done here): fn:deep-equal still reads its twenty-odd options itself (raise SXML_FUNCTION_OPTION_LIMIT from 10 and merge); two calendar arithmetics (days_from_civil in src/format_date.c, the cycle days of src/operator_temporal.c); the evaluator's navigation analysis finds fn:root by its local name (a native-function property would say it); the lowering machine (run_machine in src/xpath_lower.c) should refuse to run inside a step, as the evaluator does, since XQuery and XSLT lowering run procedures and embedded lowerings "outside a machine" by convention only and the call-cycle check cannot see through step pointers (a probe that aborts on a nested run passed all 193 debug tests at c7c0c35, so the guard breaks nothing; src/xpath_lower.c was being edited by a running packet); size products count * sizeof(type) are mostly unchecked, safe where the count mirrors an array already allocated (a lint rule could require sxml_size_multiply for the others).
